blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The reason why supporters of Vice President Sara Duterte resort to personal attacks and sexist remarks when criticizing individuals linked to the prosecution panel is that they try to avoid discussions on glaring issues, past and present, the House lawmakers said on Tuesday. During a press briefing while Duterte’s impeachment trial was on a break, prosecution spokesperson and former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers and Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V said that this has been how the Vice President’s supporters operated when she is under criticism.
